Interesting app!. I really enjoyed this app. The design is simple, self-explanatory and dark so that’s an instant plus for nighttime especially! 
I’m not one to usually go to bed with background noise but after playing around with the app, I’ve honestly grown to wanting to incorporate into my daily routine (with the Asian Fan being my hands down favorite one). What I’m also a huge fan of is the ability to lock your phone without interrupting the sounds & the ability to set a timer and bed time notification to help you stay on schedule or routine. 
The app does present ads, but they are nowhere near as pesky as some of these other apps I have tried. However, you can purchase a very affordable, monthly subscription if you’d like.
There is always room for improvement but I don’t think the app is missing anything really, it didn’t crash, it ran smoothly on my device, the sounds are pleasant and the user interface is easy to understand and maneuver. Props!!
